product_overview: PollSync is a real-time polling platform that lets users create polls without registration, share them through a public link or QR code, and watch vote results update live. Poll creators can manage their polls later from the browser session that created them.
core_goals: Create a poll quickly without signing up
Share a poll through a public link or QR code
Vote in a poll from a shared link
Manage created polls from a personal dashboard

features.name: Create poll
features.description: Create a new poll with a question, 2-10 unique answer options, and an optional expiry time using an anonymous identity.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in the question -> Fill in at least two answer options -> Optionally add or remove answer options -> Optionally select an expiry time -> Submit the poll creation form -> See a confirmation redirect to the poll page -> See the owner management panel with sharing and poll controls
Navigate to / -> Leave the question empty -> Submit the poll creation form -> See a validation toast for the missing question
Navigate to / -> Enter duplicate or empty answer options -> Submit the poll creation form -> See a validation toast for invalid options

features.name: Vote in poll
features.description: Open a public poll and cast one vote for a single option from the available choices.
user_flows: Navigate to /p/[slug] from a shared link or QR code -> Review the poll question and current status -> Select one answer option -> See a success message and the selected option highlighted -> See the results update

Navigate to /p/[slug] from a shared link or QR code -> Review the poll question and current status -> Select one answer option -> Try to vote again -> See a message that the vote was already submitted
Navigate to /p/[slug] from a shared link or QR code -> See that the poll is closed or expired -> Observe that voting choices are unavailable

features.name: Live results
features.description: View poll results in an animated chart that updates in real time as votes are cast.
user_flows: Navigate to /p/[slug] -> Open a poll with active voting -> Watch the results chart update as new votes arrive -> Observe the live connection status badge change as needed
Navigate to /p/[slug] -> Open a poll with active voting -> Hover over the connection status badge -> See the connection status tooltip

features.name: Owner poll management
features.description: Manage a poll you created by copying its link, sharing it by email, viewing its QR code, closing or reopening voting, and deleting the poll with confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to /p/[slug] -> View the owner management panel -> Copy the poll link -> Share the poll by email -> View or scan the QR code
Navigate to /p/[slug] -> View the owner management panel -> Close the poll -> See the poll switch to a closed state -> Reopen the poll -> See voting become available again
Navigate to /p/[slug] -> View the owner management panel -> Choose to delete the poll -> Confirm the deletion -> Return to /polls

features.name: My polls dashboard
features.description: View polls created from the current browser session, along with their status and vote counts.
user_flows: Navigate to /polls -> Review the list of polls created in this browser -> Open a poll card to view its details and management controls
Navigate to /polls -> See that no polls exist yet -> Observe the empty state prompt to create a first poll
Navigate to /polls -> Select New poll -> Go to the poll creation form

tech_stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19, Server Components, Server Actions)

routes.description: Landing page with poll creation form
Poll voting page with live results chart and owner management panel; returns HTTP 404 for unknown slugs
My polls dashboard listing polls created by the current anonymous session

features.name: Create poll
features.description: Create a poll without registration using an anonymous identity; question plus 2-10 unique options and optional expiry
user_interactions: Fill the question textarea
Fill at least two option inputs
Add more options via Add option button
Remove options via trash buttons
Select expiry in dropdown (No expiry / 1 hour / 1 day / 1 week)
Click Create poll button
See toast error for empty or duplicate options
Get redirected to /p/<slug> on success

features.name: Vote in poll
features.description: Participant picks one option; one vote per browser session enforced by database unique constraint via cast_vote RPC
user_interactions: Open a poll share link
Click an option button to vote
See success message and highlighted voted state
See error toast when voting twice (already_voted)
See closed/expired notice instead of vote buttons

features.name: Live results
features.description: Animated bar chart of results that updates in real time via Supabase Realtime postgres_changes with debounced reconciliation
user_interactions: Watch results chart update live as votes arrive
See realtime connection badge (Live / Reconnecting / Offline)
Hover badge for connection status tooltip

features.name: Owner poll management
features.description: Poll owner sees share link with copy button, QR code, email share, close/reopen toggle and delete with confirmation dialog
user_interactions: Click Copy link button
Scan or download QR code
Click Share by email
Click Close poll / Reopen poll
Click Delete then confirm in dialog

features.name: My polls dashboard
features.description: Lists polls owned by current anonymous session with status badges and vote counts; empty state for new visitors
user_interactions: Open My polls page from header navigation
Click a poll card to open it
Click New poll to go to creation form
